nvitk.registration.fsl.points¶

Map voxel indices between images using a FLIRT *.mat and NIfTI affines.

Functions¶

load_flirt_matrix(→ np.ndarray)

Load a 4×4 FLIRT transform (input mm → reference mm).

transform_ijk_points_flirt(→ np.ndarray)

Map (i,j,k) points from moving image voxels to fixed image voxels.

Module Contents¶

nvitk.registration.fsl.points.load_flirt_matrix(mat_path: str | pathlib.Path) → np.ndarray¶

Load a 4×4 FLIRT transform (input mm → reference mm).

nvitk.registration.fsl.points.transform_ijk_points_flirt(points: np.ndarray, moving_affine: np.ndarray, fixed_affine: np.ndarray, flirt_mat: np.ndarray) → np.ndarray¶

Map (i,j,k) points from moving image voxels to fixed image voxels.

Uses moving/fixed NIfTI affines and the FLIRT matrix from flirt -in <moving> -ref <fixed> (same as tof_to_vwi_bb.mat).
